SELECT 
    a.acct_ref,
    r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value' as risk_value,
    r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score' as trust_score,
    r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score' as impact_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value' IS NOT NULL 
          AND r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score' IS NOT NULL 
          AND r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score' IS NOT NULL
        THEN 0.4 * CAST(r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value' AS numeric) 
           + 0.3 * (1 - CAST(r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score' AS numeric)) 
           + 0.3 * CAST(r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score' AS numeric)
        ELSE NULL
    END as srs
FROM accounts a
JOIN risk_and_moderation r ON a.acct_ref = r.acct_risk
LIMIT 10;

-- Check how many accounts have all three risk values for SRS calculation
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts a
JOIN risk_and_moderation r ON a.acct_ref = r.acct_risk
WHERE r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value' IS NOT NULL
  AND r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score' IS NOT NULL
  AND r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score' IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    a.acct_ref,
    ROUND(

            + 0.3 * CAST(r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score' AS numeric)
        AS numeric), 4

FROM accounts a
JOIN risk_and_moderation r ON a.acct_ref = r.acct_risk
